title: ••Bantha Herd
caption: ••Bantha Herd (V)
game_text: Deploy on a Tatooine site. Once per turn, you may place up to 3 cards from hand face down here. You may ‘react’ to battles initiated against your lone Tusken Raider by deploying (for free) any Tusken Raider(s) and/or Bantha(s) here. {alter}
lore: While banthas are found on many worlds, the largest herds are found on Tatooine. The Sand People of that planet learned to tame the beasts.

notes: Restricted (••) on slip heading, caption and printed card. Printed base is a MOBILE EFFECT; slip banner reads EFFECT, no grabber box. Curly single quotes around ‘react’; red circle-slash A at the end → {alter}. Slip text otherwise matches the stub. Lore matches the wiki and both scans. Art: the 745 px SE-D-banthaherd.gif is tagged D-E1 (PC errata face: game text differs from the printed card) — used for art only; the printed face is SE-D-banthaherd-decipher-archive.gif (350 px, photo on a white page, also downloaded to src/vs8/). Copyright: Special Edition form, 1998 legible. Modern: Virtual Block 3 only (VB3 -pre, 350 px).
